set.body: Before promoting HsmmConfig value inspection in the supported signature closure, reject nonfinite refinement weights at its checked factory. Source inspection currently permits positive infinity; reproduce on original code, preserve lawful finite/zero behavior and canonical identity, run an assertion-level compiled mutation, and qualify the affected source/consumer gate with exact independent review. No claim that existing default refinementPasses=0 study output is affected. Parent work: bd-01M19N0W937KVZCK78F6X57X1D.
set.title: Reject nonfinite HSMM refinement weights before stable promotion
